`1488-1494`: **LGTM - Field selector correctly filters unschedulable nodes.** The fix properly addresses the race condition by using `spec.unschedulable=false` field selector, which is confirmed to be a valid selector per `NodeToSelectableFields` in `pkg/registry/core/node/strategy.go`. **Optional:** For consistency with the similar code at lines 2146-2148, consider adding an empty list check before accessing `nodes.Items[0]`: ```diff nodes, err := c.CoreV1().Nodes().List(ctx, metav1.ListOptions{ FieldSelector: "spec.unschedulable=false", }) framework.ExpectNoError(err) +gomega.Expect(nodes.Items).ToNot(gomega.BeEmpty()) node := nodes.Items[0] ``` This would provide a clearer assertion failure message if no schedulable nodes are available, rather than an index-out-of-range panic. ,
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed. In `@test/e2e/kubectl/kubectl.go` around lines 1488 - 1494, Add a guard to ensure nodes.Items is non-empty before accessing nodes.Items[0]; explicitly assert (using framework.Expect* helper) that len(nodes.Items) > 0 and provide a clear error message like "no schedulable nodes available" so the test fails with a readable assertion instead of an index-out-of-range panic when no schedulable nodes are returned by the List call. ```
